name: Monstrous Gargoyle

abilities.name: Gargoyle leap
abilities.description: When it is summoned by Quintus Verres, Monstrous Gargoyle leaps on the ground which knockbacks and stuns all targets.

abilities.name: Double Swipe
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does moderate physical damage twice.

abilities.name: Heaving Quake
abilities.description: The boss pounds the ground dealing high physical damage around itself as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.name: Petrifying Bellow
abilities.description: The boss roars stunning all players in front of itself as indicated by a large red cone. This can be broken free from.

summary: The Monstrous Gargoyle is a gargoyle boss of Volenfell. It is initially atop the Dwemer door before being awoken by Quintus Verres late in the fight, jumping down to attack the group.
